setup.title: Select FFXIV Game Directory
setup.subtitle: Supports CN only, Global only, or both side-by-side. All game files are opened strictly read-only and never modified.
setup.mode_cn_desc: Select a CN client directory to browse Simplified Chinese items, recipes, gathering maps, and version diffs.
setup.mode_global_desc: Select a Global client directory for English/Japanese game data and multi-language CSV export (EN/JA/DE/FR).
setup.mode_both_desc: Load both CN and Global clients together; primary and secondary data languages follow your selected interface language.
setup.cn_dir_placeholder: D:\Games\最终幻想XIV (paste path or drop folder here)
setup.cn_dir_guide: Choose the folder containing both "game" and "boot" subfolders (or select the "game" folder directly).
setup.global_dir_placeholder: D:\Games\FINAL FANTASY XIV Online (paste path or drop folder here)
setup.global_dir_guide: Choose your "FINAL FANTASY XIV Online" or "FINAL FANTASY XIV - A Realm Reborn" folder (or select "game" directly).
setup.valid_msg: Valid directory · Client v{version} · Read-only access ready
setup.summary_both_ready: Ready to load (read-only): CN v{cn} · Global v{global}
setup.summary_both_wait: Select valid CN and Global directories, or switch to a single-client mode
setup.summary_cn_wait: Select the CN game directory to continue
setup.summary_global_wait: Select the Global game directory to continue
setup.diag_not_found: Path not found. Please check the spelling or click "Browse..." to locate it.
setup.diag_permission: Permission denied for this folder. Please check folder read permissions.
setup.diag_unreadable: Unable to read this path. Ensure it is a valid local game folder.
setup.diag_file_found: A file was selected instead of a folder. Please choose the game installation directory.
setup.diag_file_invalid: A file was selected. Please choose your Final Fantasy XIV installation folder.
setup.diag_sub_folder: An inner subfolder is selected. Please select the outer game installation root folder.
setup.diag_boot_folder: The launcher folder is selected. Go up one level and choose the main game installation folder.
setup.diag_deep_folder: A deep resource subfolder is selected. Please choose the outer game installation folder.
setup.diag_dir_perm: Permission denied when reading this folder. Please check system permissions.
setup.diag_dir_unreadable: Cannot list folder contents. Please re-select the game installation directory.
setup.diag_parent_found: This looks like a parent folder containing "{name}". Click the button on the right to switch.
setup.diag_missing_game: Complete FFXIV game data was not found here. Make sure it contains the "game" subfolder.
setup.err_none: Please select at least one valid game installation directory.
setup.err_generic: Unable to read the specified game directory. Please verify the folder is intact and readable.
